speaker: Doctor
text:
The mention of "Pneumonia" seems like a misunderstanding of your penile and finger lesions; those symptoms are not typical for pneumonia. Given your heavy smoking history and the location of these non-healing, crusty lesions, could you describe their texture (e.g., raised, ulcerated, or warty) and if you have noticed any bleeding?

text: RESULTS: Cells with nuclear hyperchromasia, multinucleation, and increased mitotic figures within the follicle-bearing epithelium.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The biopsy results showing nuclear hyperchromasia, multinucleation, and increased mitotic figures are highly concerning for malignancy. Given the clinical presentation of non-healing, crusty lesions on the penis and finger with a heavy smoking history, do you have any other areas of skin affected, or any history of similar warty growths elsewhere on your body?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma
